name: Bo

queries.query: Bo Sierra Leone official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS parcel viewer
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Ministry of Lands, Housing and Country Planning portal, its Surveys & Mapping/GIS Directorate page, the OARG land-registration procedure, and the National Land Commission digital-portal page. These describe land registration, cadastral surveys, and planned interactive maps, but no public Bo parcel viewer or anonymous parcel API was exposed.

queries.query: Bo Salone official land registry cadastral map parcel GIS
queries.result: A separate Krio-oriented first-party discovery query did not surface a Krio cadastral viewer or parcel service. The official Sierra Leone results remained English-language Ministry, OARG, and NLC pages describing land registration, surveys, and a digital portal under development; no safe anonymous parcel geometry or native parcel ID was found.

officialSources.observation: Official MLHCP portal links land registration through OARG and cadastral survey requests through the Surveys Directorate; actions require account/application workflow and no public map endpoint is linked.

Official MLHCP GIS Directorate page states that a GIS-based National Land Information System is being developed; the page contains institutional description only, with no parcel service configuration or geometry endpoint.
Official OARG land-registration procedure describes title/search and registration steps, but it is a formal registry workflow and does not publish anonymous parcel geometry.
Official National Land Commission digital portal advertises land search and interactive cadastral maps but explicitly marks the LMIS/digital portal as under development with pilot coming soon.

requests.outcome: Fetched successfully. Current HTML exposes account/application links for land registration and cadastral survey requests; no map, API, schema, CRS, or parcel response was exposed.

registryBasis: Official Sierra Leone MLHCP and OARG pages evidence the national land-registration and cadastral-survey custodians and formal procedures applicable to land administration. This is custodian/procedure evidence only, not evidence of a public Bo parcel adapter or anonymous parcel coverage.

sourceCandidate.operator: Sierra Leone Ministry of Lands, Housing and Country Planning (Surveys & Mapping/GIS) with OARG land-registration workflow and National Land Commission LMIS initiative

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: National Sierra Leone land registration, cadastral survey, and planned land-information services; no Bo-specific public coverage claim was found.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous city-bounded parcel record, stable native parcel identity, schema, CRS, or geometry was retrieved.

remainingUncertainty: A restricted, account-gated, formal-request, or not-yet-published cadastral service may exist. The absence of an anonymous response in these bounded requests is not evidence of citywide parcel absence. No unsafe owner, address, titleholder, tax, account, or contact fields were requested, and the WUP point was not shifted.
